core.title: 2-1/2 Inch Thick Door Double Cylinder Deadbolt

text.description_html:
Schlage Commercial 2-1/2" Thick Door Double Cylinder Deadbolt

This ANSI Grade 2 double cylinder deadbolt is made for doors up to 2-1/2" thick. It is adjustable for 2-3/8 inch or 2-3/4 inch backsets. Built tough, it has a metal dust box reinforcer with three 3 inch screws.

Features of the Schlage B562/XB12209212 Deadbolt:

  • Will fit standard door preparations.
  • 1" wrought metal trim ring reinforced with security insert.
  • Metal dust box reinforcer with three 3" screws.
  • 6-pin C123 keyway.
  • Packaged with 2 keys.
  • NASI A156.5, 2001, Grade 2.
  • Backset: adjustable for either 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Door Thickness Range: 1-3/8" - 2-1/2"
  • Strike: 1-1/8" x 2-3/4", square corner, box
  • Deadbolt: 1" x 2-1/4", square corner faceplate, 1" housing diameter, 1" throw
